description: Returns the most recent revenue-path check for a given site, including its dollar-proof findings. Reads an account history, so it needs a Smoke Run API key. Returns an empty result when no check has been run for that site yet.

siteUrl.description: A public website address, for example https://example.com.

name: get_latest_findings

found.description: False when no check has been run for that site yet.

proof.description: The dollar proof of the latest check, or null when found is false.
